title: Character Bible
description: Visual and vocal consistency anchors for generated (Flow / Veo) character films: a verbatim style lock, per-character turnaround sheets and voice descriptors, the advertised product sheet, and location references. Every shot prompt is assembled from these strings verbatim.

style_lock.description: Verbatim style string prepended to every image and video prompt (e.g. Pixar-style 3D look, lighting, materials).

negative_style.description: Verbatim list of things every prompt must avoid (text on screen, subtitles, extra limbs, realism drift).

description.description: Full visual description: species/age, proportions, face, hair, outfit, colors, signature props.

turnaround_path.description: Approved turnaround sheet (front, 3/4, profile; neutral pose; plain background).

flow_media_ids.description: Flow media UUIDs of the uploaded reference sheets, reusable as --ref without re-upload.

description.description: Verbatim voice descriptor repeated in every shot where the character speaks: gender, age, timbre, pace, manner.

prompt_tokens.description: Short verbatim identity string inserted into every shot prompt featuring this character.

description.description: Exact shape, colors, materials, proportions; verbatim prompt string.

sheet_path.description: Approved stylized product sheet consistent with the style lock.

logo_path.description: Vector/PNG logo used only in compositing (end card), never generated.
